sources.note: Town of Stockbridge, DRAFT Annual Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (draft tier, disclosed; the official minutes are served only through the town's HeyGov meetings app) -- Article 1 floor elections, each by a single ballot cast by the clerk: Kent Butterfield was elected Moderator for a one-year term ending 2027.

Town of Stockbridge, DRAFT Annual Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (draft tier, disclosed; the official minutes are served only through the town's HeyGov meetings app) -- Article 1 floor elections, each by a single ballot cast by the clerk: Sharon Pavlik was elected auditor for the remainder of a three-year term ending 2028 (she had been appointed to the seat the prior year), and Doris Laing for a three-year term ending 2029 (the minutes' clarification passage notes Laing had been appointed to the term vacated by Sylvan Groth before the meeting; a later passage prints the diminutive 'Dory Laing' -- the election line's form governs). Jenny Austin, elected until 2028, already holds the third seat.

Town of Stockbridge, DRAFT Annual Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (draft tier, disclosed; the official minutes are served only through the town's HeyGov meetings app) -- Article 1 floor elections, each by a single ballot cast by the clerk: Lori Scott was elected lister for a three-year term ending 2029.
